name: sparx — HVAC (Efficiency)
tagline: A cool, technical template for efficiency-focused HVAC — book visits from day one.
description: A data-forward HVAC site for energy-efficiency pros — a cool evergreen-and-slate palette with a bright teal signal accent, built around online booking. Homeowners book an energy assessment, a free install estimate or a tune-up in about a minute; three technicians carry their own skills and hours. Leads with lower bills, heat-pump expertise and rebate help. Ships as "Northline Climate", a high-efficiency heating-and-cooling company.
